messages.subject: covariates in detection function
parts:
Hey folks,

Here a very fast question:


I'm using "ds" function to estimate detection function. I'm just interested in detection and not in density, so I don't include information about area, strata etc:

hn_cos0 <- ds(data_dz_r$Dist_det, transect = "point", key="hn", adjustment = "cos", order = 0, truncation=w_rad)
 
and I get the warning message "No survey area information supplied, only estimating detection function.", which is expected and I undestand.

However, when I try to include covariates in the detection model:

hn_cos0 <- ds(data_dz_r$Dist_det, transect = "point", key="hn", adjustment = "cos", order = 0, truncation=w_rad, formula = ~ data_dz_r $ Sp)

I get the error: "Error in checkdata(data, region.table, sample.table, obs.table, formula) : Variable(s): Sp are in the model formula but not in the data".

Obviously, If I include in my dataframe the columns "region.label", "area" etc. I can fit the model without problems.

Just to confirm: using "ds" function, it is possible to estimate detection function without include information about area, effort etc, but it is NOT possible to estimate detection function with covariates if this information is not supplied?

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] covariates in detection function
parts:
Pablo

I don't know what is contained in your data frame "data_dz_r", but a literal reading of the error message you report is the field "Sp" does not exist in the data frame.  Can you check the variable you wish to include in the detection function actually exists?

Your first argument to `ds` is also non-standard.  If you have a data frame containing distance sampling information, you would usually use the entire data frame as the first argument "data_dz_r" rather than a particular field "data_dz_r$Dist_det".  One possible solution might simply be to change the first argument to "data_dz_r" and the last argument to "Sp", as in this example:

library(Distance)
data("ETP_Dolphin")
cu <- convert_units("nautical mile", "nautical mile", "square nautical mile")
test <- ds(ETP_Dolphin, key="hn", adjustment = "cos",
          order=0, truncation=3, formula=~as.factor(Cue.type))

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] covariates in detection function
parts:
Dear Eric,

Thank you very much for your help.

I used to include a particular column of my data frame in the first argument of 'ds' function because the name wasn't 'distance'. Now, replacing my column name 'Dist_det' with 'distance' it is possible to fit the detection function with covariates without the need to include columns to estimate density. It was exactly what I need! :)

Thanks again
Best
Pablo
